questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Tuskers or Heat?
How many wickets separate the all-time #1 (Chloé Tryon) and #2 (Rasika Maharaj) wicket-takers (List A) in the 09/10 season?
questions.explanation: Chloé Tryon: 24 — Rasika Maharaj: 18 — a gap of 6.

questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
At which ground did Rhinos record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 46, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/02/03.

questions.question: Which team has finished runner-up more times than any other in this database (7), despite winning the title only twice in that span?
questions.explanation: Lions finished runner-up 7 times across List A and T20 Division 1 between 2012/13 and 2025/26, but won the title only twice.

questions.question: At which ground did Mochelle May record their career-best innings (50*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval, against Kei on 2014/11/30.
